_comment: Canonical registry of persona clones. Paths in 'repo' are RELATIVE to this repo root (clones/<name>) so the roster is portable across machines/OSes. tools/gen_agents.py resolves them to local absolute paths. status: active (system-prompt compiled) | bootstrapped (/clone-setup run, not compiled) | created (repo scaffolded from template, not bootstrapped) | planned (name only, no repo) | deprecated (retired from councils). tier: 1 primary, 2 secondary. strong_for/weak_for are ROUTING metadata only (read by tools/route.py); the persona's actual knowledge stays in its clone repo.
